effective.basis: TCG release of the Dragunity Legion Structure Deck (SDDL-EN014)

transitions.historical_text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This monster can only be Special Summoned by removing 1 WIND monster in your Graveyard from play. As long as this monster remains face-up on the field, you may change the battle position of 1 of your opponent's face-up Monster Cards at each End Phase of your opponent's turn.
transitions.modern_text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 1 WIND monster in your Graveyard. During your opponent's End Phase, you can select 1 face-up monster your opponent controls, and change its battle position.
transitions.summary: Rewording only: the continuous framing 'As long as this monster remains face-up on the field, you may change the battle position of 1 of your opponent's face-up Monster Cards at each End Phase of your opponent's turn' becomes the trigger form 'During your opponent's End Phase, you can select 1 face-up monster your opponent controls, and change its battle position', which is how official/c12800777.lua implements it (EFFECT_TYPE_TRIGGER_O on EVENT_PHASE+PHASE_END with s.poscon requiring the opponent to be turn player). The summon restriction is still strict in this version ('This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 1 WIND monster in your Graveyard').

effective.basis: TCG release of Speed Duel GX: Duelists of Shadows (SGX3-ENI21), the first printing carrying the 'Must first' form

transitions.historical_text: This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set. This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 1 WIND monster in your Graveyard. During your opponent's End Phase, you can select 1 face-up monster your opponent controls, and change its battle position.
transitions.modern_text: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 WIND monster from your GY. Once per turn, during your opponent's End Phase: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position.
transitions.summary: Wording only, on Konami's period rulings (round 036). The era text "This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 1 WIND monster in your Graveyard." says "can only be", not "cannot be Special Summoned except by". Konami's rulebook (Versions 7.0 to 8.0) lets a Special Summon Monster be Special Summoned by another card's effect once it was properly Special Summoned first, and Konami's strategy article (printed 2009-12-07) applies that to "can only be Special Summoned by" wording and keeps the permanent lock for "except by". So the era card and the errata'd "Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 WIND monster from your GY." revive alike. The same printing adds "Once per turn", inert because the effect already fired at most once, in the opponent's End Phase (this record's earlier reading), and pins the proper Summon to the hand, which the era wording leaves unstated; no source read rules on either. No difference between the era card and the modern card is established.

implementation_metadata.reason: Round 036: no generated card was shipped for this record (round 034's script was proposed and never merged; its number 600000012 stays retired). On Konami's period rulings the modern card behaves as the era card did at the snapshots this record applies at, so the modern implementation is used; no script or engine test is needed for it.

review.notes:
The text in force for both GOAT (2005-04-01) and Edison (2010-04-24) is v1 (LON-EN070, dated by Master Collection Volume 1, 2004-12-01), so the chain starts there; v0 (LON-070, 2003-03-01) differs only by lacking the explicit 'This card cannot be Normal Summoned or Set' line, which the Master Collection reprint restored before either snapshot date. 'select' to 'target' is the standard modernisation and the script carries EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET, and 'removing ... from play' to 'banishing' plus 'Graveyard' to 'GY' are vocabulary changes. This card has no upstream historical or unofficial variant of any kind.

Round 036 (2026-09-29) correction. This record's strict-nomi call ("can only be Special Summoned" read as a permanent lock) was read from the printed wording alone and cited no period ruling. Konami's rulebook, Versions 7.0 (capture 2008-12-30), 7.1 (2010-03-30), 7.2 (2011-05-16) and 8.0 (linked from Konami's Gameplay page on 2011-09-18), says of Special Summon Monsters: "You cannot use a card effect to Special Summon those monsters from your hand, Deck, or the Graveyard unless it was properly Special Summoned first." Konami's TCG strategy article (printed date 2009-12-07; earliest capture 2015-11-06) says a monster worded "This card can only be Special Summoned by..." can be Special Summoned again from the Graveyard after one proper Summon, and reserves the permanent lock for "cannot be Special Summoned except by...". Konami's Extreme Victory card rulings (compiled 2011-05-12, version 1.2; listed on Konami's Gameplay page on 2011-09-18) rule, for a card whose text is "This card can only be Special Summoned by controlling 3 or more face-up "Meklord" monsters": "If you Special Summon this card correctly, it can later be Special Summoned back from the Graveyard." This card's text says "can only be" and none of its printed texts says "except", so the era card and the errata'd card revive alike. The UDE/Konami card FAQ (Konami-hosted 2008-12-15) has no entry for the card. Evidence and its limits: docs/research/period-rulings-generated-scripts.md, sections 3 and 6.9 and the round-036 section. Not established: the Graveyard-revival answer for GOAT (2005-04-01), which is out of this record's scope. Superseded summary, kept verbatim: "The strict summon restriction became the 'Must first' form: 'This card can only be Special Summoned by removing from play 1 WIND monster in your Graveyard' became 'Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 WIND monster from your GY', so the modern card may be Special Summoned from the Graveyard once it has been properly summoned - official/c12800777.lua carries c:EnableReviveLimit() plus an EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC ranged to LOCATION_HAND and no EFFECT_SPSUMMON_CONDITION. The same printing added 'Once per turn' (inert: the effect already fired at most once, in the opponent's End Phase) and '(from your hand)', which codifies where the self-summon procedure always drew from." Superseded coverage, kept verbatim: "Project Ignis ships no historical implementation of this card; reproducing the era behaviour needs a custom script and a reserved passcode" (gap_sources ignis-babelcdb, ignis-cardscripts, yugipedia-card-errata). Superseded gap statement, kept verbatim: "In a period format the modern card can be Special Summoned from the Graveyard by Monster Reborn, Premature Burial or Call of the Haunted after one proper self-summon, which the GOAT- and Edison-era text forbids outright."
